notes.title: GIANT 'GiAnt' UPDATE!! WEAPONS! LEVEL SELECT +MORE
notes.notes:
ANTS JUST GOT HIGHER IN THE FOOD CHAIN

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11804605/b6224d2880981e4bc0d9e519c1a1da47356095c5.png

I have listened to you and have spent the last month, since releasing 'GiAnt' to Early Access, working hard on an update for you!

This update includes..

+ Improved Controls, Tips and Guidance

+ A Graphical Upgrade! (no more jumpy shadows)

+ Enemy AI that has vastly been improved! Completely Rewritten! 

+ Weapons! Our protagonist now comes equipped with a flaming Matchstick to fight with!! Too many enemies beating you down? Swing your Matchstick you crush other insects!

+ Level Select - The nest area has been taken out of the game, the story simmered down and a nice and easy Level Select screen added in its place

+ You can now collect Ant Eggs as well as the Candy Pieces! 100 Eggs gets you a GUN from the upcoming GiAnt DLC - GiAnt WARFARE

+ Health is now out of 100 and regenerates 


Thank you all for sticking by me through this bumpy first month!

Keep reporting any issues and I'll get to them for the next update! And let me know if this version is better or worse!

Thanks again,

Adam
Wreck Tangle Games


*** Note - The game has Changed A LOT!! If your save game has gone, or doesn't allow you to continue where you left off, then you last saved in an area that has gone and you may have to start again! I am deeply sorry about this! But trust me! It's worth it for this upgrade

*** Note 2 - Achievements are not active just yet! Those are what I am working on at them moment

notes.title: UPDATE 1 - Fixed death, candy and graphics
notes.notes:
2 days since release and you have all been very helpful in pointing out some issues with the game. 

Death -The main one being the death script being completely broken. When you died, it would not restart the level, rather forced you to exit the whole game. This has now been rectified. 

Tutorial screen - when you start the Garden level a quick tutorial screen comes up, but this was very messy. I have cleared this up and made it easier to understand.

Candy - People have been getting confused when there candy goes missing because an enemy ate it... This was a good idea on paper, as these candy points were going to add up at the end of the level/game. I have taken this feature out for now until it is more refined. Enemies now CANNOT eat your candy. So six candies per level to open the exit, should always be 6.

Lastly some graphical fixes, mainly to reflections.

Please - If you find any issues, bugs, crashes, problems - Let me know, I will do my best to fix any issues in the next update. Thanks again!
